sections.overview: Its range is restricted to the Alpes-Maritimes, Var and north-western Italy.
sections.identification: ITIS recognizes P. spinipennis Budde-Lund, 1885 as a valid species.
sections.habitat: It has montane affinities but also occurs near sea level.
sections.diet: The taxonomic and faunistic sources reviewed do not describe its diet.
sections.behavior: Its ecology is described as both soil-associated and rock-associated; more detailed behavior was not reported.
sections.reproduction: Species-specific reproductive information was not found in the sources reviewed.
sections.ecology: A 2026 Ligurian review warns that some old records identified as P. spinipennis actually refer to P. orarum; it also reassesses historical records of P. monticola.
sections.conservation: No global conservation assessment was located in the sources consulted.

sources.title: Isopods of the Provence-Alpes-Côte d’Azur regional checklist (2011)
